title: The payload of a signed Boundary document

Boundary.description: Boundary is the kind Boundary (bootstrap file and signed config); id "default".

issuer.description: the issuer URL of the boundary: http or https

default_tenant.description: decision D-4: the one tenant of the skeleton until Tenant items exist; empty, or a store part

acr_values_supported.description: The acr values this boundary enforces in acr_values and lists in discovery: the one list both read; a requested value that is not here is ignored. Each is visible ASCII without a quote, a backslash or a space (a request separates values by spaces), 1 to 256 bytes, and may begin with - or _; at most 16, none twice. A value that YAML would read as a number is written in quotes: "1".

token_certificate.description: Decision X1 A of 2026-11-18 (ADR 0006, "Amendment of 2026-11-18"): whether this installation publishes the token certificate. Off, which is the default and the state of the core, the key set carries no x5c member for any key, key@ gives no chain and keeps no token certificate, and the installation needs no intermediate and no certifier. On, each ES384 entry carries its chain; it needs the intermediate in the KeyPlan (the set is refused without it). key@ reads the value when it starts.
